BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald Davitt & Davitt are delighted to present this exceptional seven-bedroom detached family residence, extending to approximately 3,529 sq.ft., occupying an elevated site of approximately 1.5 acres. Located just seven minutes from Mullingar, this impressive home combines generous living space, mature landscaped gardens and panoramic countryside views, creating an outstanding family residence in a peaceful rural setting.

Presented in immaculate condition throughout, the property is approached through wrought iron entrance gates with a sweeping tarmac driveway leading to the house. Surrounded by maintained lawns, mature trees and colourful planting, the home enjoys complete privacy while offering excellent accessibility to Mullingar and surrounding amenities.

Ground Floor
A spacious entrance hall, leading to three reception rooms that provide exceptional flexibility for modern family living. The main living room features a solid fuel stove and opens into a bright conservatory overlooking the gardens, while the separate sitting room feature`s a fireplace.

The generous kitchen and dining room, complete with quality fitted units, granite splashback, solid fuel stove and ample dining space. A large utility room, guest shower room and a spacious ground-floor double bedroom complete the ground floor.

First Floor
The spacious landing leads to six generously proportioned bedrooms, providing excellent accommodation for large families. Two of the bedrooms come with en-suite shower rooms, while the remaining bedrooms are served by a well-appointed family bathroom featuring both bath and separate shower. The principal bedrooms enjoy stunning countryside views, with built-in wardrobes and excellent natural light throughout.

Exterior
Occupying approximately 1.5 acres, the landscaped gardens have been meticulously maintained and provide a wonderful outdoor environment. A large patio area overlooks the gardens, while a substantial detached garage and separate block-built basement offer exceptional storage, workshop or hobby space.

A large concrete yard, currently used as a tennis court, further enhances the outdoor amenities, while mature shrubbery, colourful planting and the gently flowing river bordering the property create an idyllic countryside setting rarely found so close to Mullingar.

Location
Ideally positioned just seven minutes from Mullingar, this outstanding residence enjoys the peace and tranquillity of country living while remaining within easy reach of schools, shops and all essential amenities. Sonna National School and church are just moments away, with the scenic Coolnahay Canal Walk nearby providing excellent recreational opportunities. Ballynacarrigy and Irishtown are both within easy reach, while the surrounding countryside offers spectacular views in every direction.

Summary.
Offering outstanding accommodation, beautifully landscaped grounds and an exceptional rural setting, this impressive family home represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial residence of exceptional quality close to Mullingar. Combining privacy, space and versatility with panoramic countryside views, this is a forever home designed for modern family living.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this remarkable property has to offer.
